products.product_description: FOOD SERVICE - Mombo s Vanilla Soft Serve Ice Cream Mix, frozen & thawed for Ice cream machines. Packaged in a half gallon carton 64 oz and placed in cases of 6-units. Shelf-life is 18 months frozen / 30 days thawed refrigerated. Carton is a plain white carton with a sticker label on one side and a code on the gable of the opposite side.
